maddeler.e:
استلهما (form X)
# اِسْتَلْهَمَا (istalhamā) /is.tal.ha.maː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَلْهَمَ (istalhama)
# اُسْتُلْهِمَا (ustulhimā) /us.tul.hi.maː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَلْهَمَ (istalhama)
# اِسْتَلْهِمَا (istalhimā) /is.tal.hi.maː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَلْهَمَ (istalhama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
